summary: Q01 to Q04 plus the v1.2.0 Q02F sibling are implemented as live PyRel queries in rai_code/queries/uc1.py and reproduce all 23 frozen result sets exactly - same columns, same ordered rows, same typed values - against PK_AVIATION_TEMPORAL on aviation_temporal_logic_s. Nothing in EXPECTED_ANSWERS.yaml was touched and no result is post-processed in pandas beyond dtype normalisation and the supplied row_id label.
scope_note: The brief named Q01-Q04. Manifest v1.2.0 also adds Q02F (fleet_storage_spell_distribution, D-0026), an aircraft-history question that QUERY_ROUTING.md does not route because that document was written against v1.1.1. UC2 owns Q05-Q07 and ROT owns Q08, so Q02F was implemented here. This is a deviation from the routing document and is recorded here rather than in DECISION_LOG.md, which is not this task's file.

model_predicates_reused.principle: No temporal predicate is retyped in uc1.py. Every interval conjunction comes from the ontology, which is the demo's differentiation claim.
reused: aviation_model.temporal.dv33_branches - the four-value DV-33 classification for Q01, which itself composes within_existence and visible_on
aviation_model.temporal.within_existence - existence_from <= d < existence_to, D-0003 exclusive finite EOL
aviation_model.temporal.visible_on - valid_from <= d < valid_to on a daily assignment
aviation_model.computed_aircraft.InServiceOnMonthEnd - the Q03 model rule holding the existence clock and the two independent daily-assignment clocks against one month end

aviation_model.core_aircraft AircraftStatusAudit / DailyAssignment / AuditAssignment / AircraftType / EngineType / AircraftStatus
aviation_model.core_aircraft DailyAssignment.previous_definition_id and .is_type_change - MODEL_INPUT-materialized, read not recomputed (Q04)
added_by_this_task: _spell_bindings() in uc1.py - not a temporal predicate but the shared spell derivation, factored so Q02 and Q02F cannot disagree about what a spell is (the SQL oracle makes the same guarantee in prose)
Q02FStorageSpellBucket - a question-private duration-bucket dimension, discussed under open_issues

things_the_ontology_could_not_express.what: DV-33 as a single derived property against an arbitrary as-of date
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.why: Two of its four values are the ABSENCE of a covering assignment, which can only be decided against a date, and a materialized rule over the Date core concept would range over an unbounded extension. temporal.dv33_branches therefore returns condition tuples.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.consequence: Q01 fires one query per (dimension, branch) until a branch fires - up to nine engine round-trips for a single-row answer. This is the whole reason Q01-CANONICAL is 142s cold and 19-29s warm while Q03's 985-row answer is 3.7s.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.workaround: None applied. Listed as a performance risk, not a correctness one.

things_the_ontology_could_not_express.what: min() and max() over a date difference
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.why: std.datetime.date.diff yields the runtime's narrow INT while min/max declare their output as the core Integer (INT128), and shims/lqp/model2lqp.py:1167 asserts the two match. Measured: 'AssertionError: min(TypeName.INT) had output type of TypeName.INT128'. count is exempt, which is why spell_count never hit it.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.consequence: Q02F failed outright on first attempt.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.workaround: std.numbers.integer(...) widens the input to match. It fails loudly at compile time, so it cannot silently corrupt a result.

things_the_ontology_could_not_express.why: The bucket bounds are deliberately irregular (0, 1-7, 8-30, 31-90, 91-365, 366-730, 731+) so they cannot be a computed step function, and rai_code/aviation_model/ is out of this task's scope.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.consequence: A query-module-local Q02FStorageSpellBucket concept is defined lazily from model.data, mirroring Q03's MonthEnd so the classification is one inequality join and Q02F stays a single query rather than seven bucket-shaped ones.
things_the_ontology_could_not_express.workaround: Works, but see open_issues - it is the one place a query module writes to the shared model, and that is not concurrency-safe.

pandas_boundary: pandas does three things and no more: normalise RAI dtypes to Python scalars (Date arrives as Timestamp, integer aggregates as Int128Array, absence as NaN), apply the frozen column order and order_by, and stamp the supplied row_id label. No filter, no join, no group-by, no coalescing of a wrong value into a right one.

open_issues.issue: Q02F's bucket dimension is added to the shared named model by a query module, and a sibling process that imports aviation_model rewrites the model definition without it.
open_issues.evidence: Q02F returned seven correct rows at the start of a pytest session and an empty frame twice later in the same session, while a sibling query agent was active. Three consecutive calls in an uncontended process all returned the correct seven rows, so it is not a repeat-call defect.
open_issues.mitigation_applied: _assert_buckets_present() runs before every Q02F query and raises a named AssertionError instead of returning an empty answer.
open_issues.proper_fix: Move the bucket dimension into aviation_model (a five-row concept in a new module, or onto calendar_dates). Not done because aviation_model is outside this task's exclusive files.

open_issues.issue: Q01 latency. Up to nine engine round-trips per single-row answer, 19-29s warm for the enriched cases.
open_issues.why: The DV-33 branch structure above. Each branch is its own query because the four-value classification cannot be materialized against an arbitrary date.
open_issues.possible_fix: Materialize NO_RECORDED_STATE intervals in MODEL_INPUT so all four dimensions become inner joins and Q01 collapses to one query. QUERY_ROUTING.md names this as the fallback design; it is a DATA-04 plus MODEL-01 change.

open_issues.issue: Q02 pairs each Storage with the MINIMAL later In Service; the SQL oracle requires the IMMEDIATE successor to be In Service.
open_issues.evidence: Measured fleet-wide on MODEL_INPUT.AIRCRAFT_DIMENSION_AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT: 439 spells under both definitions, out of 442 Storage observations that follow an In Service. They agree exactly on this fixture, so no frozen answer discriminates between them.
open_issues.guard: tests/test_uc1.py::test_q02_pairing_agrees_with_the_sql_oracle_fleet_wide computes both definitions in SQL and asserts they are equal. If enrichment ever inserts a third status between a Storage and the return, that test goes red before any frozen answer does.

open_issues.issue: Concurrency. Importing a query module is a write transaction on the model; a concurrent reader errors with 'prepareIndex: model is currently locked' rather than waiting.
open_issues.mitigation_applied: uc1.warm_model() retries through the lock and is called first by main() and by the pytest fixture.

open_issues.issue: Q02F's top bucket is closed at 3,652,500 days rather than left unbounded, because a joinable dimension needs finite rows. The longest observed spell is 1,091 days.
Q02F is not mentioned in DEMO_QUESTIONS.md or QUERY_ROUTING.md. Both predate manifest v1.2.0. Neither is this task's file to update.

independent_corroboration.sql_oracles: data/run_oracles.py --question Q01 --question Q02 --question Q02F --question Q04 --skip-probes reports 21 passed, 0 failed, all_green=True in 82.3s. The RAI answers and the independent SOURCE-only SQL oracles agree on every Q01-Q04 and Q02F result set.
